Faro Salazón Hotel
Discover Sanxenxo’s town centre
Located in the centre of Sanxenxo, this hotel is the perfect destination for those looking to enjoy both the beach and the nightlife. In addition, guests can enjoy private parking (extra charge) in the surrounding area (reservation required).

Opinions
Reviews from our guests
We were a group of 5 and were accommodated in two connecting rooms on the top floor, simple room, nicely decorated and clean. Many thanks to the guy at the reception. The hotel is close to everything, beach, restaurants, bars etc. We’ll be back.
Estheruki
We booked several rooms and, even though the room was a bit hot, the location was excellent, it was clean and the rooms were large and comfy. I would repeat without hesitation.
Olaya_ap
Cleanliness. In these pandemic times, it is highly valued. Breakfast is average but you fill yourself up. Permanently supervised by a waitress to ensure disinfection and safety distance. Perfect location. No noises, you close the window and that’s it.
Mijoshe
I went on holiday to this hotel and I was surprised that it had so many negative reviews because I was there with my wife and my son and everything was great, excellent price, in the centre of Sanxenxo very new and well equipped room, all good; there’s a bit of noise from the street but nothing as exaggerated as I read in comments I will come back for sure.
Furrus
